searchText: so when do you think it would be fine for EL to stop serving arvhive logs to be safe? so you could have put a very high ancient barrier and not DL old blocks and receipts at all but if everyone would do it it would reduce network health <vdWijden> I think we can start thinking about it once portal and the era format are kinda established standards that work. I suspect that this will be at least 2 years from now yes waiting for that and then eip-4444, but I'm already thinking about it 😄 I can understand that. We should explore potential designs that doesn't break proposer shuffling invariant, if nothing satisfying is found then postpone this fix
